TED's youth and education initiative, TED-Ed, aims to spark and celebrate student ideas around the world. The TED-Ed Student Talks Program supports students in discovering, exploring and presenting their big ideas. Members meet regularly to discuss, develop and craft presentations in the form of short TED-style talks. 

Within the curated TED-Ed Student Talks YouTube channel, you will see inspiring youth Talks and TED-Ed Student resources. To learn more about TED-Ed's Student Talk Program or to join, visit https://ed.ted.com/student_talks
